usedFor: TagMango sells creator content, and Dropbox saves a file when “New Order Created” runs “Upload File to Dropbox”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in TagMango, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: Each order can drop a file into a chosen Dropbox folder, replacing or keeping older copies.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” saves from a public web link, so the file must be reachable at one.
